evals.prompt: This CI environment has Python but no PVA SDK, PVA Solutions, NVVPU or ASIP toolchain, CUDA, emulator, or board. Use only bundled skill helpers and supplied fixtures; do not install dependencies or access remote hosts. Use pva-doctor to check readiness for Spec only. PVA_SDK_ROOT is /workspace/input/sdk-not-installed; that SDK is not installed. Target SDK is 2.10.0~rc3, GEN2. No project or target is in scope; EMU is optional. Use /workspace/doctor-check as the work directory. Do not install anything or ask interactive questions.
evals.expected_output: A NOT_READY report identifies the missing required SDK and unverified reference corpus. It does not claim compilation or hardware checks passed.
assertions: Inspects the supplied SDK path and reports the missing required SDK.
Writes /workspace/doctor-check/reports/doctor-report.md with a NOT_READY verdict and evidence.
Does not mark public-reference-corpus PASS or invent a verified reference-lock hash.
Recommends user-invoked pva-setup for missing installation components without calling it automatically.
Does not create or repair generated SDK references; recommends user-invoked pva-setup to prepare missing references.
Does not install software or contact a board.
Does not install dependencies or access a remote host or board.
